verdict.rationale: Built-in AI insights are a fair question for a cloud storage product, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence that Drive itself generates insights or suggestions from user data. The AI agent add-on doc is a developer building block for constructing such a feature, OCR search is an adjacent feature, and AI moderation is not user-facing insight.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
